disclaimer: This is an engineering review, not a security certification. It records what was verified and what remains open.

resolved.title: Password never verified
resolved.evidence: auth.py::login read `password` and never compared it.
resolved.resolution: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, 240k iterations, per-user salt, constant-time compare.

resolved.title: Unknown emails auto-provisioned on login
resolved.evidence: auth.py:47-57 created an account for any unknown email.
resolved.resolution: authenticate() raises UnauthenticatedError; no account is created.

resolved.title: Anonymous fallback user on /me
resolved.evidence: auth.py:105-108 returned a default planner without a token.
resolved.resolution: resolve_session() raises; @require_auth guards every scoped route.

resolved.title: No authorization / project isolation
resolved.evidence: Projects had no owner; all state was process-global.
resolved.resolution: ProjectRegistry enforces ownership; cross-owner access is 403.

resolved.title: No upload validation
resolved.evidence: ingestion_dynamic.py accepted any file, any size, any count.
resolved.resolution: Extension allowlist, 25 MB/file, 10 files/request, size measured from the stream.

resolved.title: Debug server and open CORS
resolved.resolution: Debug opt-in and disabled in production; host defaults to 127.0.0.1; CORS origins from NETGRAVITY_CORS_ORIGINS.

open_risks.title: Credential and session store is in-process and non-durable
open_risks.detail: Accounts, sessions, projects, snapshots and scenarios are lost on restart and are not shared across workers. A deployment should front this with a real IdP and a persistent store.

open_risks.title: No rate limiting
open_risks.detail: Login and solve endpoints accept unlimited requests; a MILP solve is expensive and is reachable by any authenticated user.

open_risks.title: No CSRF protection
open_risks.detail: Bearer-token auth in a same-origin SPA limits exposure, but no explicit CSRF defence exists for cookie-based deployments.

open_risks.title: Prompt-injection surface unreviewed
open_risks.detail: Chat input reaches the LLM gateway. Numeric grounding constrains what the model may assert, but injection resistance was not systematically tested in this phase.
